answer: Each identity holds a karst thread that loses 50% of its weight every epoch without verified work. Renewal costs $10 times the square of threads one operator already holds; the tenth costs $1,000, the hundredth $100,000. Only threads above half weight enter the haven. Five auditors sample 5% of renewals each epoch and check the work trail within 48 hours. A thread with no fresh work crumbles to zero, its haven slot shut for ten epochs. Keeping 100 clones standing costs $3,383,500 against $1,000 for 100 honest agents, the way limestone caves stay open only while water keeps carving them.
